ui.no_presets: No valid presets. Set pairs like 25/5 in settings.
ui.checking_body: Waiting for the first probe to come back.
ui.patch_hint: Install the Hyprland plugin from github.com/Aceix/hyprmodoro, which exposes the hyprctl commands this plugin uses to control the timer: hyprpm add https://github.com/Aceix/hyprmodoro && hyprpm enable hyprmodoro && hyprpm reload

err.absent_body: Enable it with `hyprpm enable hyprmodoro && hyprpm reload`.
err.readonly_body: Hyprland is running a Lua config, where upstream hyprmodoro's controls cannot be reached. Install the build from github.com/Aceix/hyprmodoro to enable them. The timer still displays correctly.
err.link_failed: Could not update the main Hyprland config
err.already_linked: The main config already requires this file
err.linked: Added require("{module}") to your Hyprland config

config_path.label: Settings file
config_path.description: Generated file holding your hyprmodoro options. A .lua path is written for a Lua config, .conf for hyprlang.

manage_config_file.label: Manage the settings file
manage_config_file.description: Turn off to stop overwriting the file and configure hyprmodoro by hand.

defer_writes.label: Defer writes while a session runs
defer_writes.description: Saving reloads Hyprland, which resets a running pomodoro's durations. Leave on unless you want changes written immediately.

presets.label: Presets
presets.description: Comma-separated work/rest pairs in minutes, e.g. 25/5, 50/10. First six are shown.

poll_running.label: Poll interval while running
poll_running.description: hyprmodoro emits no events, so the timer is polled. Milliseconds.

poll_idle.label: Poll interval while idle
poll_idle.description: Milliseconds. Higher means fewer hyprctl calls at rest.

show_when_idle.label: Show duration when idle
show_when_idle.description: Off shows only the icon until a session starts.

glyph.label: Bar icon
glyph.description: Used while idle. A running session shows the phase icon instead.

enabled.label: Enable hyprmodoro
enabled.description: Turns the Hyprland-side plugin on or off.

work_duration.label: Work duration
work_duration.description: Minutes. This is the default hyprmodoro starts with; presets override it until Hyprland reloads.

auto_transition.label: Auto-transition
auto_transition.description: Roll straight into the next session. Forced on when the window title is disabled.

title_reserve_space_all.label: Reserve title space on all windows

title_position.label: Title position
title_position.description: Left and right are always drawn as an overlay.

title_overlay.label: Draw as overlay
title_overlay.description: Float over window content instead of resizing the window.

border_color.label: Border colour
border_color.description: Used when the source above is Custom.

border_alpha.label: Border opacity
border_alpha.description: 0–255. Hyprland colours carry their own alpha.

text_waiting_prefix.label: Waiting prefix
text_waiting_prefix.description: Shown between sessions when auto-transition is off.

sound_player.label: Sound player
sound_player.description: Command used to play the files below, e.g. pw-play.

sound_work_end.label: Work-end sound
sound_work_end.description: Sounds only play when the player and both files are set.

notification_use_system.label: Use system notifications
notification_use_system.description: notify-send instead of Hyprland's own overlay.

border_color_source.label: Border colour source
border_color_source.description: Accent derives a high-contrast colour from hyprtoolkit's accent at each config load; Custom uses the colour picker below.
